cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Make the Choice Rewrite the Past
cards.instruction: Make them choose between options whose consequences reinterpret an earlier promise, refusal, or agreement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Keep my spare key or return it. Either choice explains last week's 'take some space.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Then keeping it can mean the evening ended.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Would make that evening the beginning of something neither of us named.
